from fontTools.ttLib import TTFont
from pathlib import Path
for p in Path('font-corpus').glob('*'):
    try:
        f=TTFont(str(p), lazy=True)
        if 'fvar' in f:
            axes=f['fvar'].axes; inst=f['fvar'].instances
            defs=tuple(a.defaultValue for a in axes)
            has=any(tuple(i.coordinates.get(a.axisTag, a.defaultValue) for a in axes)==defs for i in inst)
            print(p.name, 'axes', len(axes),'inst',len(inst),'default?',has,'tables', sorted(f.keys())[:10])
    except Exception as e:
        pass
